'''Vardax''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], and the [[Galactic War]], who resided on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. He was killed by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] forces during the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|liberation]] of the planet along with his apprentices.

==Behind the scenes==
Vardax first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion enemy NPC on the Republic version of Balmorra, where he and his two apprentices block the way to the stat-boosting Datacron 57 in the Gorinth Canyon.
